cases.name: Katie Marie Sullivan
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "We will remember all the good times Katie had growing up at Plim Island, Salisbury Beach, South Hampton, NH and Amesbury where she graduated from high school. Katie moved to Florida and later to South Carolina where she worked for many years as a hair stylist and then became a dental
technician, a job that she loved. Katie was a victim of domestic violence."
